aiResearchSummary.text: AnyVision Interactive Technologies Ltd. is focused on enhancing object detection and face recognition technologies. Their R&D efforts include applying adaptive class thresholds to improve ML models for object detection, ensuring accurate feature vector labeling from images. Additionally, they are developing methods to increase face recognition reliability using drone-mounted sensors, involving adaptive drone positioning for target identification. These advancements aim to bolster real-time threat detection capabilities, aligning with their mission to protect individuals and assets.
